description: The Xinjiang Institute of Ecology and Geography identifies extreme low-temperature events across the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor for 1961–2015. The workflow applies thresholds and duration rules to daily minimum temperatures on a quarter-degree grid, excluding areas outside its low-temperature definition. ScienceDB describes MATLAB MAT files under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The events can define cold-weather exposure scenarios for transport and other infrastructure simulations. Grid-scale event detection does not establish temperatures at individual assets, and threshold choices introduce uncertainty when comparing this record with other extreme-weather inventories. Asset fragility or disruption functions must be supplied separately. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: A gridded dataset of Extreme low temperature events over China-Pakistan Economic Corridor during 1961-2015
